<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#0B1112"/>
      <stop offset="0.58" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#263939"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hero" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#728887"/>
      <stop offset="0.48" stop-color="#314545"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#050707"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="promo" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#182626"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#728887"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="7" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".65"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="soft" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".5"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <text x="18" y="21" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>

  <rect x="355" y="13" width="16" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="376" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <circle cx="29" cy="59" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <polygon points="29,45 31,56 40,59 31,62 29,73 27,62 18,59 27,56" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.1"/>
    <text x="53" y="58" font-family="Nobile" font-size="18" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing="1.6">Mercedes-Benz</text>
    <text x="53" y="74" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" fill="#728887" letter-spacing="2.4">WELCOME HOME</text>
    <line x1="345" y1="51" x2="374" y2="51" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <line x1="345" y1="67" x2="374" y2="67" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="20" y="111" font-family="Aubrey" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF">Welcome, Alex</text>
  <text x="20" y="132" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" fill="#AAB7B6">Explore a world made for you.</text>

  <!-- Hero carousel card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="150" width="350" height="236" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".55"/>
    <rect x="20" y="146" width="350" height="236" rx="23" fill="url(#hero)"/>

    <circle cx="315" cy="181" r="24" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".25"/>

    <text x="42" y="212" font-family="Nobile" font-size="30" fill="#FFFFFF">EQS SUV</text>
    <text x="42" y="234" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" fill="#E8EFEE">Progressive luxury, redefined.</text>
    <!-- abstract vehicle illustration -->
    <polygon points="72,316 102,278 149,261 234,260 290,284 327,316 321,329 68,329" fill="#10191A" opacity=".88"/>
    <polygon points="127,276 153,268 224,268 256,285 123,285" fill="#728887" opacity=".65"/>

    <line x1="224" y1="269" x2="243" y2="284" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".35"/>
    <rect x="108" y="308" width="44" height="7" rx="3" fill="#7EC0F6"/>

    <circle cx="284" cy="326" r="15" fill="#050707" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity=".45"/>
    <circle cx="284" cy="326" r="6" fill="#728887"/>
    <text x="42" y="360" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" fill="#FFFFFF">Discover the electric future</text>
    <polyline points="333,354 341,360 333,366" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="178" cy="401" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="20" y="438" width="350" height="116" rx="23" fill="#000000" opacity=".5"/>

    <text x="40" y="523" font-family="Aubrey" font-size="26" fill="#FFFFFF">is just a button away.</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="282" y="466" width="66" height="31" rx="13" fill="#728887"/>
      <text x="315" y="486" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Quick actions -->
  <text x="20" y="590" font-family="Inter" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Quick access</text>
  <text x="315" y="590" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" fill="#7EC0F6">See all</text>

  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="20" y="606" width="108" height="91" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".45"/>
    <rect x="20" y="602" width="108" height="91" rx="18" fill="#172525"/>

    <text x="163" y="686" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#9DAEAC">2 updates</text>
  </g>
  <g filter="url(#soft)">
    <rect x="262" y="606" width="108" height="91" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".45"/>
    <rect x="262" y="602" width="108" height="91" rx="18" fill="#172525"/>
    <circle cx="294" cy="632" r="18" fill="#728887"/>
    <line x1="285" y1="632" x2="303" y2="632" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="623" x2="294" y2="641" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="284" y="686" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#9DAEAC">Connect now</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="0" y="724" width="390" height="120" fill="#050808" opacity=".97"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="724" x2="390" y2="724" stroke="#728887" stroke-opacity=".35"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="38,758 50,748 62,758 62,773 38,773" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polyline points="34,758 50,744 66,758" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <ellipse cx="342" cy="769" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#728887" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="342" y="794" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" fill="#728887">Profile</text>

  <rect x="160" y="827" width="70" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".7"/>
